title: TANGO2 AGX — LLM Stage Performance
description: Fixed-shape greedy benchmark. Latency trends, phase/case snapshots, and collapsed diagnostics. Exact 5m sample statistics. Internal AGX observation, not an external serving or official TC5 verdict.

options.content: Fixed input lengths / output limits · greedy decoding · one active request. **Trends:** exact last-5-minute statistics, not per-request samples. **Bars:** current phase/case comparisons. Each case receives 10 requests per cycle (~75–80s). See eligible counts below; fewer than 30 samples is exploratory.

panels.title: TTFT p50
panels.description: Request acceptance to first generated non-EOS token. Includes input preparation and prefill. Internal AGX consumer boundary.

panels.title: E2E p50
panels.description: Request acceptance to completed internal response delivery. Model load and raw-record publication are outside this interval.

panels.title: TPOT p50
panels.description: Per-request (last token − first token)/(N−1). Undefined for N<2. This is not a GPU-only timer.

panels.title: Decode tok/s
panels.description: Median per-request (N−1)/(last token − first token). Board-wide output throughput is shown separately.

panels.title: First-token latency · 5m distribution
panels.description: Exact statistics of completed requests in the last 5m. Shading is the observed min–max range; lines are p50/p95. This is an aggregate trend, not individual requests. Hover shows 0.001ms digits. Empty intervals remain gaps.

panels.title: Request latency · 5m distribution
panels.description: Exact statistics of completed requests in the last 5m. Shading is the observed min–max range; lines are p50/p95. This is an aggregate trend, not individual requests. Hover shows 0.001ms digits. Empty intervals remain gaps.

panels.title: Prefill · host and GPU
panels.description: Current last-5-minute phase statistics. The host call includes GPU execution and its existing wait; these bars overlap and must not be added. Prefill processes the prompt and produces the first token.

panels.title: Decode · generation and GPU
panels.description: Generation is first-to-last token elapsed time; GPU is the sum of subsequent decode stream intervals. Overlapping measurements, not additive stages. Bars are snapshot comparisons, not a continuous execution trace.

panels.title: GPU prefill · compare all cases
panels.description: All six cases, exact last-5-minute p50. Compare input-length sensitivity for prefill and output-length sensitivity for decode. These panels intentionally ignore the case dropdown.

panels.title: GPU decode · compare all cases
panels.description: All six cases, exact last-5-minute p50. Compare input-length sensitivity for prefill and output-length sensitivity for decode. These panels intentionally ignore the case dropdown.

panels.title: Board throughput · all cases
panels.description: Board-wide successful, non-warmup output tokens and requests per elapsed second, including idle/reload gaps. Prometheus rate is extrapolated over 5m. This differs from per-request decode speed.

panels.title: Eligible samples · last 5m
panels.description: Fewer than 30 samples for a metric means that metric is insufficient. ITL counts individual token intervals; the other rows count eligible requests. Empty metrics have no samples.

panels.title: CPU execution · instrumented threads
panels.description: Exact last-5-minute p50 in detail mode. Only the request worker and consumer are measured; runtime helper threads are outside scope. Stage scopes overlap the worker request and are not additive. Decode + finalize runs from prefill end to worker completion, not first-to-last token generation. Runnable wait is scheduler queue delay, not GPU/I/O blocking or runner admission queue. Missing measurements stay absent; see per-counter eligible counts in Collection quality.

panels.title: Runnable CPU wait · instrumented threads
panels.description: Exact last-5-minute p50 in detail mode. Only the request worker and consumer are measured; runtime helper threads are outside scope. Stage scopes overlap the worker request and are not additive. Decode + finalize runs from prefill end to worker completion, not first-to-last token generation. Runnable wait is scheduler queue delay, not GPU/I/O blocking or runner admission queue. Missing measurements stay absent; see per-counter eligible counts in Collection quality.

panels.title: Input and prefill preparation
panels.description: CPU-side preparation before the prefill call. Separates text/tokenizer work from runtime context/buffer setup.

panels.title: Text conversion and publication
panels.description: Cumulative host costs inside generation. They overlap generation elapsed time and do not measure external network delivery.

panels.title: Token pacing · TPOT and ITL
panels.description: TPOT gives one average per request; ITL gives individual token gaps and weights longer responses more. Both exclude N<2 and are not GPU-only timings.

panels.title: First token and first nonempty text
panels.description: Generated token availability and the internal consumer's first visible text can differ because a token may yield empty text or wait for publication.

panels.title: Unattributed host interval
panels.description: Queue is this serial runner's admission-to-start gap, not a production server queue. Remainder closes E2E accounting and is not an independently attributed runtime stage.

panels.title: Output length · actual tokens
panels.description: Actual generated tokens expose early EOS; the selected case specifies an output limit.

panels.title: Utilization
panels.description: Platform context for latency changes; time correlation alone does not establish cause.

panels.title: Clocks
panels.description: Platform context for latency changes; time correlation alone does not establish cause.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Platform context for latency changes; time correlation alone does not establish cause.

panels.title: Power by rail
panels.description: AGX INA3221 rails. DDR/1V8AO is included in system 5V; do not add or stack rails.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Platform context for latency changes; time correlation alone does not establish cause.

panels.title: Collection and producer health
panels.description: Endpoint and producer are separate. The runner reloads between cycles; producer heartbeat can be briefly absent. A heartbeat older than 5s means stopped/stale.

panels.title: Completion reasons
panels.description: Diagnostic counters include warmups. Normal performance statistics exclude warmups, errors and invalid records.

panels.title: CPU observation availability
panels.description: All cases since the collector restarted. Complete/partial/unavailable/invalid concern CPU observation only; legacy and disabled runs have no CPU measurement. Host/GPU latency remains independently eligible.

panels.title: CPU eligible samples · last 5m
panels.description: Each CPU scope and counter has its own eligible request count. Zero samples means unavailable or absent observation, not zero CPU work or zero wait. Fewer than 30 samples is exploratory.
